clues: This city stands on a wide river in the heart of Europe. Hills rise on one bank, and a broad plain spreads out from the other.
Winter here can be cold and dim, with snow in most years. Night cold can drop far below freezing from mid December to mid February.
A hill town on the river became the land's capital in 1361. Kings then ruled from its castle for a long time.
Two old towns face each other across the river, Buda and Pest. In 1873 they joined with a third town to form one city.
The parliament of Hungary sits in this city, in a grand building by the river. The nation's leaders do their work here too.
